_readme: Update policy. minBuild = BLOCKING (anything below is locked out). latestBuild = dismissible prompt. Both compare against the BUILD number (the +N in pubspec.yaml), not the version name. Next release is build 100. AFTER that release is live and approved in the store, set latestBuild to 100 to prompt, and minBuild to 100 to force. Leaving both at 1 keeps this dormant.
